title: Front-Loaded First Instalments for Microsoft 365 Subscriptions with an Earlier Late-Charge Record
content:
**Front-loading clause.** A Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) client with an earlier late-charge record carries a front-loaded first instalment in a payment arrangement.

**Which late charges count.** Count the late charges posted on the subscription less than twenty-four whole months before the arrangement. Late charges posted less than one whole month before the arrangement are not counted.

**Shares carried by the first instalment.**

- two or more such late charges: the first instalment carries **one and a half** of the equal shares (1.5 shares);
- exactly one: it carries **one and a quarter** shares (1.25 shares);
- none: no front-loading applies.

The late charges and their posting dates are read from the subscription's billing ledger.

## Counting window (hypothetical arrangement on 20 August of this year)

| Late charge posted on | Counted? |
|---|---|
| 1 August of this year | No. It is less than one whole month before. |
| 1 July of this year | Yes |
| 1 September two years earlier | Yes. It is less than twenty-four whole months before. |
| 1 August two years earlier | No. It is twenty-four whole months or more before. |

## Shares at a glance

| Counted late charges | Shares in the first instalment |
|---|---|
| 0 | no front-loading |
| 1 | 1.25 |
| 2 or more | 1.5 |

**Hypothetical illustration.** The equal share is 250.00 USD. With two counted late charges, the first instalment carries 1.5 shares, which is 375.00 of the spread amount. With one counted late charge, it carries 312.50.
